summary: Exclude batch-scoped metadata.raw_storage_refs from SourceRecord version identity while preserving already-persisted legacy digests, distillation job IDs, registry IDs, DLQ/retry_wait/pending rows, and resolving re-ingested legacy snapshots to their already-committed source version and job.

incident_context.symptom: On accepted backend e231f856, one unchanged Taiwan equity market SourceRecord (tw-official:tw_price_daily:TWSE:2330:e4b598d99f084c19) produced two source version digests (a9a675e5bc226bb07fd3b673c43106f0f095620780b1815fa4ab012ef0128ba1 and 573592d07e1217121b934d50b7e922df8282b867ef294e629199c581be1e71bb) and two completed distillation jobs (distill-35169d5c1df1f4c8a80ba470 and distill-926134262a5ce64486fa721d) across two batch pulls despite identical content_ref and normalized content.
incident_context.root_cause: services/source_ingestion/pipeline.py compact_bulk_market_record attaches all batch-scoped raw archive pointers to each compacted market SourceRecord under metadata['raw_storage_refs'] (40 refs). services/source_ingestion/distillation_worker.py source_version_identity only excluded ingest_run_id, source_ingest_run_id, and trace_id, hashing metadata.raw_storage_refs into the content version digest.
incident_context.resolution: Updated source_version_identity in services/source_ingestion/distillation_worker.py to exclude raw_storage_refs alongside ingest_run_id, source_ingest_run_id, and trace_id; added source_version_digest_matches and _legacy_raw_refs_source_version_digest to recognize pre-repair digests computed with raw_storage_refs; updated DistillationJobQueue._resolve_committed_source_digest and DistillationJobQueue.get so re-ingestions of pre-repair rows resolve to the existing committed version and job inside the existing admission transaction; updated DistillationController._build_registry_payload in services/source_ingestion/distillation_controller.py to validate job.source_digest via source_version_digest_matches so existing pending, retry_wait, DLQ, and redriven jobs pass registry sync without mutating their source_digest, job_id, or registry_id.

acceptance_verification.ac1_batch_raw_storage_refs_excluded: passed: two normalized SourceRecord snapshots of one source_id differing only in metadata.raw_storage_refs or run-local fields (ingest_run_id, source_ingest_run_id, trace_id) resolve to one source_version_digest and one distillation job_id; enqueue_source_record admits no second version and creates no second outbox job
acceptance_verification.ac2_governed_fields_change_version: passed: any change to title, content_ref, source_type, connector_id, trust_tier, provenance, or governed metadata fields (such as record_digest, symbol, market) produces a distinct source_version_digest and a new distillation job
acceptance_verification.ac3_legacy_persisted_jobs_processable: passed: pending, retry_wait, DLQ, and redriven jobs persisted under the previous digest projection keep their source_digest, job_id, and registry_id and pass the registry sync digest check in distillation_controller.py (_build_registry_payload) without raising a digest mismatch
acceptance_verification.ac4_reingest_legacy_row_resolves_to_exis: passed: re-ingesting a SourceRecord whose content was previously admitted under the legacy projection (with raw_storage_refs included in the digest) and that differs only in raw_storage_refs resolves to the already-committed source_digest and job_id in source_version_ledger and distillation_jobs without admitting a replacement version or second job
acceptance_verification.ac5_minimal_in_place_scope: passed: repair stays strictly inside services/source_ingestion/distillation_worker.py and services/source_ingestion/distillation_controller.py; no new cache, registry, mapping table, service, schema migration, or gate is added, and no persisted outbox/inbox/lease/DLQ row or identifier is rewritten or deleted
acceptance_verification.ac6_synthetic_tests_and_before_after_sui: passed: 6 new synthetic regression tests fail on parent commit c4d33e4faa1bd035ef9ec9a39dbdce3a68c6c2f7 and pass on the delivered head; full services/source_ingestion/tests suite passes on both parent and delivered head

new_regression_tests_on_unmodified_paren.summary: 5 failed, 2 warnings in 3.37s (all new regression assertions fail on unmodified parent commit c4d33e4faa1bd035ef9ec9a39dbdce3a68c6c2f7 before code repair)
